name: physical-ai-studio-readme-demos
description: Source files for the animated demos on the Physical AI Studio README.

scripts.render:api: remotion render src/index.ts ApiDemo out/api-demo.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 --log=error && ./scripts/to-gif.sh out/api-demo.mp4 ../../assets/readme/api-demo.gif
scripts.render:cli: remotion render src/index.ts CliDemo out/cli-demo.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 --log=error && ./scripts/to-gif.sh out/cli-demo.mp4 ../../assets/readme/cli-demo.gif
scripts.render:gui: remotion render src/index.ts GuiDemo --public-dir=public out/gui-demo.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 --log=error && GIF_FPS=8 GIF_WIDTH=900 ./scripts/to-gif.sh out/gui-demo.mp4 ../../assets/readme/gui-demo.gif
scripts.render:install: remotion render src/index.ts InstallDemo out/install-demo.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 --log=error && ./scripts/to-gif.sh out/install-demo.mp4 ../../assets/readme/install-demo.gif
scripts.render: npm run render:api && npm run render:cli && npm run render:gui && npm run render:install && npm run render:policies && npm run render:build && npm run render:docs
